unredacted.symptom: A single idiom — one that converts a missing input into a plausible successful value — was found at many independent sites across the engine. An instance of it had already been found and repaired months earlier as OQ-93 (`system_gradient`'s `[] -> 0.0`); the repair had been applied at the site where it was found, and the same shape at the other sites had never been looked for. The OQ-97 close-out is titled for what it censuses: a Pattern-6 success-shaped-absorption census over all top-level `prolog/*.pl`.
unredacted.mechanism_as_described: The idiom takes several surface forms, and the census sorts them into three greppable shapes: a numeric default in an else-branch (Shape A, 160 raw lines across 38 files), a findall/setof/aggregate_all whose empty collection is folded to a value (Shape B, 227), and a constant atom default (Shape C, 210). Triaged into 19 classes, the confirmed candidates are: a statistic computed over an empty collection returning 0.0 (class A2 — the `system_gradient` twin, breadth); absence certifying cleanliness, where `CC = 1.0 % No coupling = clean` and `EX = 1.0 % No extraction data = clean` at `purity_scoring.pl:80/:88` make a missing datum pass the clean gate (class A6, the OQ-43 semantics); a caught error collapsing to zero mass (class A10, `json_report.pl:415-418`, where the catch arm AND the failure arm both emit 0.0); and a probe whose silence is read as agreement, feeding the OQ-98 verdict join as absence-of-alert one level below a banner that had itself already been repaired (class C4a) — so the repaired surface sits on top of an unrepaired input. Each form is locally defensible and none raises an error, so no check at any individual site can detect the class; the defect is visible only in the distribution, which nothing was measuring. The sound classes are sound for a stateable reason and the source states it: a findall over a directly-defined rule IS the look, so an empty result is measured-empty (class B1, the large majority of the 227 Shape-B rows), and `maplist(force_obstruction, Constraints)` preceding the `cached_obstruction` aggregation excludes didn't-look by construction (class A8). Where that reason is unavailable the class stays a candidate: an untyped node contributing no contamination may be intended semantics, but the aggregate cannot distinguish it from didn't-look (class A7).
unredacted.detection_path: A bounded grep for the SHAPE rather than for any symptom, with denominators recorded at execution (`ls prolog/*.pl | wc -l` -> 106 files, a superset of `stack.pl`'s 47 load directives) and positive controls proving the search could retrieve instances already known to exist — two controls fired for Shape A, two for Shape B, three for Shape C. The controls did real work rather than decorating the method: two Shape-C grep iterations were REJECTED by the pinned controls before the final pattern, because a bare-atom version missed the compound-term default `pass(no_extraction_data)` and a no-comment-tolerance version missed defaults followed by a trailing `%` comment; Shape A was then regenerated with the same comment tolerance, 149 -> 160 lines. The controls matter because the search's output is a list, and an empty or short list is otherwise indistinguishable from a clean system. The census also witnesses a prior repair: `drl_core.pl` returns zero Shape-A hits because OQ-44 commit C removed its `Value = 0` default, and the grep that fires 160 times elsewhere returns nothing in it.
unredacted.consequence: Multiple sites were carrying verdict-grade and diagnostic-grade outputs computed on absent inputs; the candidate classes were filed as OQ-112 under a file-don't-fix policy, with no engine `.pl` modified (`git diff --stat` witnessed at commit — ISSUES.md, KNOWN_STATE.md and audits/ only). None of the candidates sits on the `dr_type` classification path, which was the pre-registered halt condition and was checked. The search's own limits were declared rather than discovered, which is the Pattern-6 discipline applied to the census itself — the bound is declared, not silent: a fixed 3-line proximity window that cannot see the split form of the idiom (a findall whose list is summed in a different predicate), class verdicts generalised from one to three read witnesses per idiom, and a denominator scoped to statically declared load directives, which does not cover a runtime `consult/1` with a computed path.

unredacted.symptom: Found by the OQ-93 grid-viability probe. The system-level gradient metric `system_gradient` read exactly 0.0000 on every input it had ever been given, including the pre-registered story designed to produce +0.588. The pattern verdict derived from it was correspondingly always `stable`. Nothing errored, and the value was plausible: 0.0 is what a genuinely flat input should produce. On the same five runs the sibling calibration metric C4 kappa was exact on all five stories (0.80 / 0.20 / 0.50 / 0.49 / 1.00), so the machinery was demonstrably reading authored data correctly.
unredacted.mechanism_as_described: A build-discipline spine, twice over, with two necessary conditions that both held. First: `time_point_in_interval/2` (`coercion_projection.pl:27`) ended in a `!` annotated with the comment '(Optimized)', which made it FIRST-SOLUTION-ONLY — always T_start — instead of enumerating. Its sole caller, `coercion_gradient`'s future-points `setof`, therefore never found a future point, and every gradient computation failed. Second: `system_gradient`'s `[] -> 0.0` fallback mapped that empty collection to a plausible value, emitting a success-shaped zero for as long as the cut existed, including the entire shim era — and this probe ran with the shim DISABLED (`grid_shim_enabled=false`, the OQ-96 interim), so every grid point was authored. The 0.0 fallback is a fabricated default that made a failed computation indistinguishable from a flat result at every read site; the cut itself belongs to the bound-probe/clause-order family — an 'optimization' that silently changed an enumerator into a semidet. A consequence the probe had to correct in the record: the stable-only basin was never data starvation alone, because even the shim's injected constant points could not have produced a nonzero gradient — the cut, not the diet, guaranteed `stable`.
unredacted.detection_path: A pre-registered probe with five hand-authored stories whose correct outputs were computed in advance and committed before the run (`e7e78a1b`), including non-flat ones. The break localized because the sibling metric read its authored data correctly on the very same runs while this one returned 0.0 — the C4/C1 split placed the break downstream of magnitude, and the disagreement between two metrics over one input was the signal, not any error.
unredacted.consequence: Every gradient the construct ever computed had failed, and the failure was indistinguishable from a real measurement of flatness at every consumer. A control story authored to be genuinely flat could not be distinguished from total blindness until the cut was removed. After the one-character fix the five stories reproduce their pre-computed values exactly (+0.5880 / -0.5880 / 0.0000 / +0.1560 / +0.9800, better than the pinned tolerance), and the authored-flat control's 0.0 is now distinguishable from blindness because the same run shows the twins at plus and minus 0.588. The repair also let the probe witness a second, separate death: with the maximal reachable gradient of 0.98 against a strict threshold of 1.00, `intent_engine`'s top verdict `structural_coercive_intent` is unreachable on the metric domain by arithmetic. On the live corpus the fix changed nothing — stories have no leveled grid, so their gradients still fail to 0.0 and still read `stable` — and the full validation suite came back green.

unredacted.symptom: Stories whose `claimed_type` was `mountain` — contradicted by several independent structural checks — nonetheless summarized as yellow. The contradicting checks (dirac, cohomology, maxent, context_gap) had all run and all disagreed; each disagreement was then recorded as an expected_conflict, so the summary showed one unresolved abductive tension where there were four. Nothing in the output indicated that classifying those disagreements as expected was itself a consequence of a correction the same system had applied moments earlier. This is the OQ-138 `false_summit_mountain` clause of the FSM `resolve_modal_signature_conflict`.
unredacted.mechanism_as_described: The FSM overwrote the story's computed `dr_type` with `tangled_rope`. Separately, `diagnostic_summary` suppresses divergences known to be normal for the type the story holds — a sensible rule, since some subsystems characteristically disagree with certain types. But the type they were tested against was the overwritten one. The override had moved the story into precisely the type in which a structural second-classness (Dirac) and a descent failure ARE normal, so the disagreements arrived pre-explained via the override-keyed `signature_override_artifact` and `pre_post_override_divergence` patterns plus `constructed_type(tangled_rope)`, and were filed rather than raised. Remove the override — flip `config.pl:488` `false_summit_override_target` from `tangled_rope` to `mountain`, so the mountain-input clause head binds `Result = Target = ModalType` and no overwrite occurs, while the unknown-input clause returns `unknown` on the OQ-37 honest-abstain precedent with zero live fires — and the original type returns; the same unchanged disagreements are then abnormal for it and surface as genuine. `verdict_join` moves from yellow to red with no measurement changed and no change to `claimed_type`. The suppression rule was never about the evidence — it was keyed to a type the system had assigned to itself.
unredacted.detection_path: Running the full pipeline before and after removing the override over an identical corpus (`PIPELINE_OLD.txt` vs `PIPELINE_NEW.txt`, all 92 live seats), and requiring every unaffected seat to come out byte-identical — 89 of 92 were, across claimed_type, signature, verdict_join, base and grade, which isolated the three affected seats and made the change in their verdicts attributable to the override and nothing else. The decisive step was that the change ran contrary to what had been written down in advance: the plan predicted the verdict would go GREEN and it went RED, and the discrepancy was investigated instead of accepted. Generality was then established with `twin_sweep.pl` on `testsets_flash` (overlay-took-effect witnessed: 960 loaded), reproducing the earlier breadth result exactly at 40 FSM fires = 18 vic=0 + 22 vic>0 on the same 22 named seats, and across five corpora totalling roughly six thousand stories all 82 affected seats carried the same structural disagreements — so the three were not special.
unredacted.consequence: For as long as the override was in place, stories whose `claimed_type=mountain` was structurally contradicted reported the contradiction as expected and summarized yellow. The concealment is self-reinforcing: the more decisively the override moves a story, the more completely the evidence against it is classified as normal. From any output, a genuinely mild case and a suppressed severe one are indistinguishable — the same verdict colour, the same conflicts listed as expected. The converted behaviour makes those seats report red, which reads as a regression and is the opposite: it is what the override had been hiding. Two of the three drop from grade=correction to grade=commentary under victim-discriminated severity, and `maxent_top_type=mountain` now AGREES with the reverted type.

unredacted.mechanism_as_described: The request carries `enable_thinking:false`. The service accepts it and returns normally; nothing in the response says the setting was ignored. The one observable that would show it — `thoughtsTokenCount`, the count of reasoning tokens actually consumed — sits in the response metadata and is not part of the result the experiment reads, so an arm can be labelled 'reduced' on the strength of the request rather than of the behaviour. Belief that the flag worked came from a single earlier one-shot probe where the count fell from 972 to 292; kimi's reasoning volume varies widely between draws at roughly 4-5k tokens, so one before-and-after pair is not distinguishable from noise, and the drop was read as the flag taking effect. The consequence propagates quietly: two conditions meant to differ on the manipulated variable are in fact two independent heavy-reasoning draws of the same condition, and any contrast between them measures draw-to-draw variation while carrying the name of the manipulation. The parallel arm on `gemini-2.5-flash`, where the same kind of setting DID take effect, produced a clean contrast — 0 / 0 tokens under think_off against 2782 / 1229 under think_max — which is what made the failure visible by comparison rather than in isolation.
unredacted.detection_path: The write-up opens with a table headed 'What actually varied (honest instrumentation note)': intended condition against the measured `thoughtsTokenCount`, per probe, per model. Filling that table is what exposed it — the gemini row confirms the instrument reads the quantity correctly and that a working setting shows up as a zero, so kimi's rising counts cannot be dismissed as a reporting artifact. The earlier 972 -> 292 probe was then re-read as a draw from a noisy distribution rather than as a manipulation check. Raw data: `battery/parity_responses.json`.
unredacted.consequence: The arm the parity test was built around did not exist. Reported honestly, its verdict is carried entirely by the within-gemini reasoning contrast plus a kimi replication across two same-condition heavy draws, and the specific question the arm was designed to answer — whether kimi stays sharp when its reasoning is suppressed — is recorded as not tested. Had the counts not been tabulated, the study would have reported a manipulation that never happened and attributed a null result to it; the two kimi conditions would have differed slightly, as independent draws do, and the difference would have been read as an effect of the variable that never moved. What the surviving arms do establish is a negative about the other model: gemini's stance thinness is intrinsic rather than a reasoning deficit, since max reasoning made it a more organized Disciple rather than a Critic and returned the same five stock seats on the perspective-diff probe.
